what_for.text: Your doctor prescribed this medicine to treat your osteoporosis.
what_for.evidence: Your doctor has prescribed Alendronic Acid to treat your osteoporosis.

what_for.text: It helps prevent bone loss and rebuild bone after menopause.
what_for.evidence: Alendronic Acid prevents the loss of bone that occurs in women after they have been through the menopause, and helps to rebuild bone.

what_for.text: It lowers the risk of spine and hip fractures.
what_for.evidence: It reduces the risk of spine and hip fractures.

how_to_use.text: Take one Alendronic Acid tablet once a week.
how_to_use.evidence: Take one Alendronic Acid tablet once a week.

how_to_use.text: After getting up, swallow the tablet whole with a full glass of water only, before eating, drinking, or taking other medicine.
how_to_use.evidence: After getting up for the day and before taking any food, drink, or other medicine, swallow your Alendronic Acid tablet whole with a full glass of water only

how_to_use.text: Do not lie down for at least 30 minutes after taking it.
how_to_use.evidence: Do not lie down stay fully upright (sitting, standing or walking) for at least 30 minutes after swallowing the tablet.

how_to_use.text: After swallowing your tablet, wait at least 30 minutes before eating, drinking, or taking other medicine.
how_to_use.evidence: After swallowing your Alendronic Acid tablet, wait at least 30 minutes before taking your first food, drink, or other medicine of the day

how_to_use.text: If missed, take one tablet the morning after you remember.
how_to_use.evidence: If you miss a dose, just take one tablet on the morning after you remember.

see_doctor_now.text: Stop taking and call your doctor if you get swallowing pain or heartburn.
see_doctor_now.evidence: If you develop difficulty or pain upon swallowing, chest pain, or new or worsening heartburn, stop taking Alendronic Acid and contact your doctor.

see_doctor_now.text: See your doctor at once if you get allergic face or throat swelling.
see_doctor_now.evidence: See your doctor immediately if you notice any of the following side effects ... allergic reactions such as hives; swelling of the face, lips, tongue and/or throat, possibly causing difficulty breathing or swallowing

see_doctor_now.text: See your doctor immediately if you have mouth or jaw pain, mouth swelling or sores, jaw numbness or heaviness, or loose teeth.
see_doctor_now.evidence: See your doctor immediately if you notice any of the following side effects ... pain in the mouth, and/or jaw, swelling or sores inside the mouth, numbness or a feeling of heaviness in the jaw, or loosening of a tooth.

see_doctor_now.text: Contact your doctor if you feel pain or discomfort in your thigh or hip.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Contact your doctor if you experience pain, weakness or discomfort in your thigh, hip or groin as this may be an early indication of a possible fracture of the thigh bone.

side_effects.text: Very common: bone, muscle, or joint pain which is sometimes severe.
side_effects.evidence: Very common (may affect more than 1 in 10 people): ... bone, muscle and/or joint pain which is sometimes severe.

side_effects.text: Common: stomach pain, constipation, bloating, indigestion, or diarrhoea.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people): ... abdominal pain; uncomfortable feeling in the stomach or belching after eating; constipation; full or bloated feeling in the stomach; diarrhoea; flatulence

side_effects.text: Common: headache, dizziness, tiredness, or swelling of hands or legs.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people): ... headache; dizziness ... tiredness; swelling in the hands or legs.

side_effects.text: Uncommon: nausea, vomiting, blurred vision, rash, or red eyes.
side_effects.evidence: Uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people): ... nausea; vomiting ... blurred vision; pain or redness in the eye ... rash; redness of the skin

storage.text: Keep out of the sight and reach of children.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.

storage.text: Do not use after the expiry date stated on the carton.
storage.evidence: Do not use this medicine after the expiry date which is stated on the carton after EXP.

storage.text: This medicine does not require any special storage conditions.
storage.evidence: This medicinal product does not require any special storage conditions.
